title: Empty Walsh character is the constant one
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number. The Walsh character $\chi_\emptyset$ associated to the empty subset of $[n]$ is the constant function equal to $1$ on the Boolean hypercube; that is, $\chi_\emptyset(x) = 1$ for every $x \in \{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: S is the empty subset of [n]
